result.title: Seeing 3D Occupancy Through Scene-Adaptive Projection
result.summary: Vision-based 3D occupancy prediction infers voxel-wise geometry and semantics from multi-view images, where 2D-to-3D view transformation is a crucial step. Many existing methods adopt a backward-projection paradigm, projecting uniformly distributed 3D reference points onto image planes to aggregate multi-view features. However, their scene-agnostic sampling patterns overlook the non-uniform distribution of scene geometry, allocating many references to empty space and reducing sampling efficiency under a fixed sampling budget. To address this challenge, we propose SAP, a scene-adaptive projection framework that leverages depth-based geometric priors to guide view transformation. Specifically, we back-project metric depth maps predicted by a frozen depth model into 3D space to obtain geometric priors. To leverage these priors, we design a Scene-Adaptive Projection Encoder comprising two complementary components. First, Prior-Guided Reference Generation constructs a hybrid reference set for feature sampling, allocating references within prior-supported height regions and retaining full-range sampling where valid support is unavailable. Furthermore, to account for potential spatial misalignment caused by depth estimation errors, Radial-Structured Feature Aggregation explores multiple candidate locations through learned radial offsets to aggregate potentially displaced feature evidence. Extensive experiments on Occ3D demonstrate that SAP achieves state-of-the-art performance and consistently improves results across diverse occupancy frameworks.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 SAP 场景自适应投影框架，用冻结深度模型预测的度量深度作为几何先验，引导多视图到 3D 的视角变换：先按先验支持区域构造混合参考点集，再用径向学习偏移在多个候选位置聚合特征，在 Occ3D 上取得最优结果并可提升多种占据框架。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「按几何先验分配参考点」与「多候选偏移聚合以补偿估计误差」的思路，可能为 LVR 中的视觉证据筛选、采样预算分配及内部状态中的几何信息保真提供参考，但该文属纯 3D 感知任务，能否迁移到 VLM 推理尚需核查。
